set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system radius-server [parameter1].explanation: Configures a RADIUS server with the specified parameters, such as IP address, port, and shared secret, for network authentication and accounting purposes.

secret [parameter2].explanation: Configure IP addresses and shared keys for RADIGUS servers.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.explanation: A shared key to communicating with the RADIGUS server.

authentication-port [parameter2].explanation: The `authentication-port [parameter2]` command in Junos specifies the UDP port used for RADIUS or TACACS+ authentication, where `[parameter2]` defines the port number.

parameters.name: authentication-port
parameters.explanation: The authentication port number of the RADIUS server.

accounting-port [parameter3].explanation: The `accounting-port [parameter3]` command in Junos specifies the UDP port number used for sending RADIUS accounting messages to the RADIUS server.

parameters.name: accounting-port
parameters.explanation: The accounting port number for the RADIUS server.

set system services dhcp pool [parameter.explanation: This command configures a DHCP pool with the specified parameter1, defining a range of IP addresses for dynamic allocation to clients on the network.

network [parameter2].explanation: The command `network [parameter2]` in Junos configures a network route or interface by specifying the network address or prefix defined in `[parameter2]`.

parameters.name: network-address
parameters.explanation: The network address and subnet mask of the DHCP pool.

default-router [parameter2].explanation: Configure the default gateway to the DHCP address pool.

parameters.name: default-router
parameters.explanation: Default gateway address for the DHCP address pool.

dns-server [parameter2].explanation: Configure DNS server addresses for DHCP pool.

parameters.name: dns-server
parameters.explanation: DNS server address for DHCP pool.

set system login user [parameter1].explanation: This command fragment configures a user account on a Junos device, where `[parameter1]` specifies the username for login authentication and management access.

plain-text-password [parameter2].explanation: The command `plain-text-password [parameter2]` sets a plain-text password for a user or service, where `[parameter2]` specifies the actual password value.

parameters.name: password
parameters.explanation: The plaintext password of the logged-in user.

set system authentication-order [paramet.explanation: Configure the authentication order of the system.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address [parameter3].explanation: Configures an IPv4 address (`[parameter3]`) on a logical interface (`unit [parameter2]`) within a physical interface (`[parameter1]`) in Junos OS.

vlan-id [parameter4].explanation: The command `vlan-id [parameter4]` assigns a specific VLAN identifier (`[parameter4]`) to a VLAN interface or traffic in Junos OS.

parameters.name: vlan-id
parameters.explanation: **VLAN ID**: The VLAN ID is a unique identifier used to distinguish different Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs) within a network. It is a 12-bit field, allowing for a range of values from 1 to 4094. The VLAN ID is essential for network segmentation, enabling devices within the same VLAN to communicate while isolating traffic from other VLANs.

pppoe-client dial-pool [parameter3].explanation: The command `pppoe-client dial-pool [parameter3]` configures a PPPoE client interface to use a specific dialer pool identified by `[parameter3]` for establishing the connection.

family ethernet-switching vlan members [.explanation: Configure the VLAN members of the interface.

pppoe-options [parameter3].explanation: The `pppoe-options [parameter3]` command in Junos configures PPPoE (Point-to-Point Protocol over Ethernet) settings, where `[parameter3]` specifies a specific PPPoE option or parameter.

parameters.name: pppoe-options
parameters.explanation: The option for the PPPoE interface, such as dialin.
